cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no prominent strong anionic; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Lauroyl Methyl Isethionate @2 with prominent amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Hydroxysultaine @3 and nonionic Decyl Glucoside @10. Counter-signals: a broad mild-anionic system (Potassium Cocoyl Glycinate @4, Disodium Cocoyl Glutamate @5, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @7, plus the soap Potassium Cocoate @6, read as a carboxylate mild anionic); formula not known complete and source tier 4, so a missing or misread strong anionic cannot be excluded. Confidence moderate, neighbor moderate (N-ALT).

conditioningLevel.rationale: high by C2: early (prominent, E3) silicones Amodimethicone @34 and Divinyldimethicone/Dimethicone Copolymer @35, cationic polymers Polyquaternium-10 @30, Polyquaternium-11 @31, Guar Hydroxypropyltrimonium Chloride @32, pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @37, deliberate humectants Sodium Hyaluronate @13, Panthenol @14, Glycerin @48; plus prominent oils @24-26, protein @28, Quaternium-95 @52. Counter-signal: all deposition sits after a long run of botanical extracts in a 78-entry list (plausibly small amounts each) and the formula is not known complete; neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Every deposition route sits at @24 or later behind eight botanical extracts in a 78-entry list, so each is plausibly a small amount; late cleansing surfactants (@36-@57) show the list is not in descending order below about 1 %, which also blurs what is truly prominent. Formula not known complete.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W-RICH holds: material payload_lipid (three oils @24-26, before the W-line @63) converging with silicone (@34, @35) and cationic (@30-32, @52) systems, and reset is limited (C6 low mild chassis, resetCapacity weak). Independently, the convergence route holds: silicone + cationic polymer + material payload_lipid + protein film, all plausibly persistent (amodimethicone and a silicone copolymer).
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: moderate would require reset to offset the converging deposition; a mild C6 chassis does not. The realistic argument for moderate is that each route is plausibly trace, which the frozen list cannot decide.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: ID-1 not_known_complete forces low confidence for Section 6; the moderate/high boundary is also closely balanced on unknown amounts (W3).
weightPotential.rationale: high (low confidence, provisional): W-RICH with limited reset and multiple converging persistent families (6.6, 6.7 W-RICH, W-LINE); ID-1 and W3 cap confidence at low; P0 keeps the heavier band.

uncertainties: Potassium Cocoate @6 / Sodium Laurate @57 (soaps) read as mild anionic carboxylates; alternative: unlisted class. Neither reading creates a strong anionic, so C6 low is unchanged; the W-line stays @63 either way.

Alcohol ethoxylates (Laureth-9/10, Trideceth-12, C11-15 Alketh-7, C12-13 Alketh-23/-3) read as solubilizers outside the C3 cleansing classes; reading them as cleansing surfactants would not move the W-line (@63) or C6.

Weight high vs moderate rests on unknown amounts of late routes; recorded at low confidence (ID-1, W3).
